title: Mga Glitch sa Guniguni
summary: This is the portfolio that won me the Ateneo College Awards of the Arts in Poetry and the Mulry Award. I had fun collecting previous work and compiling it, and realizing I have built my voice as a poet in college.

title: René
summary: Published in Heights Ateneo. Originally written during my first year and slowly refined as I grew. Deeply personal self-reflections, done as a meditation on René Magritte's work.

title: Linear Algebra Short Notes
summary: Short notes for a long test in Linear Algebra during my master's, mainly covering inner products.

title: Bayesian Techniques
summary: Notes for a Bayesian techniques class during my master's.
